changes: Graphical settings choose User settings or This project; project edits use .vscode/keybindings.json and existing framework WORKSPACE scope above USER and DEFAULT. Raw entries retain their exact scope/index. Editing a lower-scope row creates an override in the selected destination, not a write to the other file.

Project file is watched inside its existing admitted single local workspace. Malformed JSON retains the last valid keymap; a missing/ambiguous/nonlocal project has no writable destination. Workspace changes clear previous bindings, and URI/generation checks retire stale edit snapshots. Cross-root switch guard is source-reviewed, not exercised against another admitted project.

Negative project entries expand matching lower USER and DEFAULT conditions. Reset/removal modifies only the selected scope, restoring the underlying bindings. Equal keymaps skip reregistration to avoid mutual reload loops between scope listeners.
Both scopes preserve JSONC and existing provider etag/mtime writes, reject changed disk snapshots and dirty JSON editors. This does not add a new atomic backend CAS guarantee.
